lines.cyr: по лепи нивја, по лепи лозја.
lines.lat: po lepi nivja, po lepi lozja.
lines.en: through beautiful fields, through beautiful vineyards.
All the fields stood up straight,
stood up straight and bowed down.
The cursed ervil neither stood up straight,

lines.cyr: ни простум стана, ни се поклана.
lines.lat: ni prostum stana, ni se poklana.
lines.en: neither stood up straight, nor bowed down.

lines.cyr: род да ми родиш, род да ми родиш,
lines.lat: rod da mi rodiš, rod da mi rodiš,
lines.en: may you bear fruit, may you bear fruit,

lines.cyr: а во *литурја да не ми влезиш,
lines.lat: a vo *liturja da ne mi vleziš,

lines.cyr: *ајван и правта да ми те јаде.
lines.lat: *ajvan i pravta da mi te jade.
lines.en: may animals and dust eat you.
